import pprint
import random

class Unorderable:

    def __repr__(self):
        return str(id(self))

def _t():

    class _SelfNS:
        pass
    self = _SelfNS()
    self.a = list(range(100))
    self.b = list(range(200))
    self.a[-12] = self.b
    n = 20
    keys = [Unorderable() for i in range(n)]
    random.shuffle(keys)
    skeys = sorted(keys, key=id)
    clean = lambda s: s.replace(' ', '').replace('\n', '')
    assert clean(pprint.pformat(set(keys))) == '{' + ','.join(map(repr, skeys)) + '}', ('assertEqual', clean(pprint.pformat(set(keys))), '{' + ','.join(map(repr, skeys)) + '}')
